steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Gate. A request is checked against the approver's limit, its reason code and duplicates.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 refund is above the approver's limit

findings.title: Amount above the approver's limit
findings.fix: Send the request to the next approver

findings.title: Duplicate request for the same case
findings.fix: Merge the requests and refund once

outcome.notChecked: Whether the refund is deserved; the payment itself.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.

pros: Checks an amount above the approver's limit, a request with no reason code, and a duplicate request for the same case.
cons: Not checked: Whether the refund is deserved; the payment itself.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-cs-refund-request skill on the records for this review.
